name: Walt Disney World Railroad

attributes.description: A vintage steam-powered train that circles the perimeter of Magic Kingdom, with boarding stations on Main Street, U.S.A., in Frontierland, and in Fantasyland.

sources.title: Magic Kingdom Attractions and Rides | Walt Disney World Resort

needs_verification: As of 2026-09-15, the official site lists three boarding-station entries (Main Street U.S.A., Frontierland, Fantasyland) but shows posted hours only for the Main Street and Fantasyland stations — the Frontierland station shows no operating hours. A separate fan-site search summary corroborates that the railroad is currently running only as a Main Street <-> Fantasyland shuttle with the Frontierland stop excluded, likely due to nearby Frontierland construction. Confirm current route/stations before recommending a full-loop ride.
